queries_run: SDSS DR19 PhotoObj and SpecObj 30 arcsec cone, centered on the Gaia position.
NASA NED 30 arcsec coordinate cone; IRSA AKARI IRC cone within 45 arcsec.
notes: Independent review of source identity, prior classification, optical signal and counterpart confusion. VarWISE uses NEOWISE data and is a prior study of the same variable signal. The optical apertures and conservative flags support small changes.

findings.summary: The W1/W2 variability is already catalogued. VarWISE cluster 2540580983592406 is flagged suspect_period despite its LPV classifier label.

findings.summary: ASAS-SN finds small optical seasonal changes across the infrared event.
findings.evidence: review/evidence/2026-11-17/asassn-seasonal.csv. Six same-image control stars support a 0.065-mag seasonal g range across 870 nights.
